discovered_jobs.title: Daily Artist (Project Based)
discovered_jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY Fox News MediaFOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month. JOB DESCRIPTION FOX News Media is looking for a Daily Artist. As a Daily Artist, you are responsible for producing creative and visually compelling graphics to support daily editorial content on Fox News Media platforms including Fox News Channel, Fox Business, Fox Weather, and Fox Nation. You are a graphic designer who thrives in a live news environment. You are willing to learn and understand the positive attitude and the level of commitment needed for a quick turnaround. This is a full-time, project-based role needed until approximately June 2027. * To be considered you must submit a link to your portfolio. * A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES Fulfill quick-turnaround requests for charts, maps, logos, fullscreens, and other custom topical images based on show needs Design engaging key art and build toolkits for our OTT platforms Typeset and proofread text-based artwork such as promos, factoids, and infographics Animate full screen graphics including scrolls, text tears, diagrams, and maps Cut out and retouch headshots Design logos and custom elements for upcoming news events Work with management and editorial to determine the best way to tell each story Pitch and storyboard concepts for new shows and specials Build out elements for broadcast, print, and digital based on established brand guidelines or animation packages WHAT YOU WILL NEED Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design/Communication preferred, or equivalent experience Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and After Effects on both Windows and Mac with experience working in a live TV or OTT environment Strong understanding of design principles, layout, typography, and color theory Ability to fulfill a high volume of daily graphic requests while conforming to established network-wide and show-specific design standards Ability to organize information (layout design, infographics, general composition) Knowledge of current design trends in graphic design and typography Excellent time-management and multi-tasking skills to meet all deadlines without sacrificing accuracy or quality of work. Must be able to handle multiple concurrent projects Ability to receive assignments and feedback from team members at all levels Knowledge of Ross XPression Maps and Google Maps strongly recommended Ability to work a flexible schedule that may include weekends or overnights UI/UX experience is a plus Knowledge of Maya, Cinema 4D, and other industry technology is a plus We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law. Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $28.75-33.65 per hour for high cost labour markets such as but not limited to New York City and Los Angeles, $23.75-28.00 per hour for all other US locations. This role is also eligible for various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents. Benefits for Union represented employees will be in accordance with the applicable collective bargaining agreement. View more detail about FOX Benefits. Originally posted on Himalayas

discovered_jobs.title: Solutions Architect
discovered_jobs.description_text: Job Description: Solutions Architect Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a diversity of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers. This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career. The Impact You’ll Make in this Role As a Solutions Architect, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by: Leading technical engagement with hyperscale datacenter customers and compute/networking silicon vendors, establishing new contacts and building lasting relationships. Implementing trusted, side-by-side technical partnerships, translating their roadmaps and architecture requirements into actionable input for 3M product and technology teams. Determining how emerging AI datacenter trends should shape the technology roadmap for 3M’s EBO program and communicating these insights to the broader datacenter team. Supporting sales, applications engineering, and product development teams by providing deep technical context on customer architectures, use cases, and integration requirements. Building conceptual demos and supporting technical marketing initiatives that showcase 3M EBO capabilities to hyperscale and datacenter audiences. Your Skills and Expertise To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Optical/Photonics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or other technical field (completed and verified prior to start) Five (5) years of experience working with hyperscale datacenter customers, AI architectures, optical interconnect, or co-packaged optics (CPO) technologies in a private, public, government or military environment Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include: Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical/Photonics Engineering, or a related technical field from an accredited institution Direct experience engaging with XPU, compute, or switch vendors on system architecture and optical interconnect integration for AI/ML infrastructure Skills include strong technical communication, customer focused, self-starting, relationship building, innovation, collaboration Work location: Remote, Bay Area CA. Travel: May include up to 30% domestic and international travel Relocation: May be authorized Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status). Supporting Your Well-being 3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope. Chat with Max For assistance with searching through our current job openings or for more information about all things 3M, visit Max, our virtual recruiting assistant on 3M.com/careers. Applicable to US Applicants Only:The expected compensation range for this position is $164,612 - $201,193, which includes base pay plus variable incentive pay, if eligible. This range represents a good faith estimate for this position. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant knowledge, training, skills, work location, and/or experience. In addition, this position may be eligible for a range of benefits (e.g., Medical, Dental & Vision, Health Savings Accounts, Health Care & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Disability Benefits, Life Insurance, Voluntary Benefits, Paid Absences and Retirement Benefits, etc.). Additional information is available at: Faith Posting Date Range 10/07/2026 To 11/06/2026 Or until filledAll US-based 3M full time employees will need to sign an employee agreement as a condition of employment with 3M. This agreement lays out key terms on using 3M Confidential Information and Trade Secrets. It also has provisions discussing conflicts of interest and how inventions are assigned. Employees that are Job Grade 7 or equivalent and above may also have obligations to not compete against 3M or solicit its employees or customers, both during their employment, and for a period after they leave 3M.Learn more about 3M’s creative solutions to the world’s problems at www.3M.com or on Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn @3M.Responsibilities of this position include that corporate policies, procedures and security standards are complied with while performing assigned duties.Safety is a core value at 3M. All employees are expected to contribute to a strong Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) culture by following safety policies, identifying hazards, and engaging in continuous improvement.Pay & Benefits Overview: does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of race, color, sex, national origin, religion, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Please note: your application may not be considered if you do not provide your education and work history, either by: 1) uploading a resume, or 2) entering the information into the application fields directly. 3M Global Terms of Use and Privacy Statement Carefully read these Terms of Use before using this website. Your access to and use of this website and application for a job at 3M are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms. Please click on the following links and select the country where you are applying for employment to review the applicable Terms of Use (link here) and Privacy Policy (link here). Before submitting your application, you will be asked to confirm your agreement with the terms. Originally posted on Himalayas

discovered_jobs.description_text: Job Description JustPlay is looking for a creative and performance-driven Video Editor & Motion Designer to join our growing Creative team. In this role, you’ll create engaging, high-performing video content for mobile-first audiences and help shape creatives that drive measurable results across our marketing channels. You’ll combine video editing, motion design, and generative AI to bring creative concepts to life, from initial brief through final delivery. Working closely with the Creative and User Acquisition teams, you’ll continuously experiment, iterate, and find smarter ways to produce impactful ads at scale. Job Responsibilities Own and manage end-to-end video production, from creative brief and concept through to final delivery Create high-quality video edits, motion graphics, and animations tailored for mobile advertising Integrate AI-generated video, image, audio, and text assets into creative production workflows Identify, structure, and execute creative concepts aligned with campaign and performance goals Collaborate closely with the Creative team to ensure strong creative execution and brand consistency Continuously iterate and optimise creatives based on performance data and learnings Explore, organise, and optimise the use of AI tools and workflows to increase creative efficiency, speed, and output quality Stay close to creative and market trends to identify new formats, ideas, and opportunities Job Requirements 2–4 years of professional experience in video editing and motion design, ideally within advertising, performance marketing, mobile apps, or mobile games Strong portfolio showcasing ad-focused video content, including both traditional/manual editing and AI-enhanced creative projects Strong skills in AI generation and prompting across video, image, audio, and text Strong video editing and motion design skills, with a good understanding of pacing, storytelling, and visual communication Experience creating mobile-first, performance-driven content for digital and social channels Comfortable using performance insights and feedback to iterate on creative work Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with different stakeholders You are proficient in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator Figma Generative AI tools for creative production, such as ChatGPT / Claude, Seedance, GPT Image, Nano Banana, Kling, ElevenLabs, or similar platforms Motion graphics and animation Sound editing and post-production workflows Nice to Have Experience working specifically with mobile games or app advertising Experience researching creative trends and competitor activity to identify new concepts and formats Familiarity with a broader range of emerging AI creative platforms and workflows Job Benefits Work-Life Balance and Flexibility : Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers Mental Health Support : Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work Training & Development : A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply Germany-Based Benefits : 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution State-of-the-Art Equipment : Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed A Relocation Package : Includes visa support for those who need it Berlin Office Perks : Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment. Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer. About us Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining modell. Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse. With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype. Everyone's welcome here At JustPlay, we believe different perspectives help us build better products. With team members from 30+ nationalities, different experiences and backgrounds are an important part of how we work and grow. We hire based on skills, potential, and how you work. Your age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or background don't come into it. If you don't meet every requirement in this ad, apply anyway. discovered_jobs.description_text: Marketing Student Assistant Are you studying marketing, communications or business and looking for a student job where you can build hands-on marketing experience and see how it all comes together in practice? Weâre looking for a structured and proactive Marketing Student Assistant to join our Brand & Marketing team at Copenhagen Optimization. Youâll work alongside our Head of Marketing, Growth Marketing Manager and Content Strategist, helping us turn plans into action across digital, events, content and campaigns. Itâs a hands-on role with plenty of variety and room to take on more responsibility as you grow. What you'll work on Website & digital: Update and maintain website content, event and campaign pages, and help keep everything accurate and up to date. Events: Support conferences and events around the world â from registrations and exhibitor portals to materials, print orders, attendee lists and deadlines. Content & campaigns: Support campaign execution by preparing content assets, landing pages, lists and other campaign elements. Marketing coordination: Keep calendars, project pages, assets and plans organized, coordinate smaller deliverables and follow-ups, and help make sure the practical details don't fall between the cracks. Creative support: Help adapt or create simple marketing materials and visuals. Experience with Canva, Figma or similar tools is a plus. Who we're looking for You are studying marketing, communications, business or a related field , ideally with at least one or two years of your studies remaining. We donât expect you to know everything from day one â what matters is that youâre curious, eager to learn and interested in how marketing works in practice. You: Communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken. Work in a structured way and keep track of tasks and deadlines. Take initiative and care about the quality of what you deliver. Are comfortable working with digital tools. We use HubSpot, Notion, Dropbox and LinkedIn, but you don't need to know them all already. Are interested in marketing and keen to learn across different disciplines. Who is Copenhagen Optimization? Copenhagen Optimization is the company behind Better Airport , our software platform built for intelligent airport operations. We work with airports around the world to connect planning, resource management, staffing and day-of operations, enabling them to make better operational decisions every day. Founded in Copenhagen in 2014, we have offices in Copenhagen and Boston and customers across Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific and beyond. What we offer Approximately 15â20 hours per week , with flexibility around your studies, exams and personal life. Youâll join a small marketing team, work closely with experienced colleagues across the business and gain hands-on experience in international B2B marketing. discovered_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager – High-Touch Onboarding
discovered_jobs.description_text: Headquarters: Delaware URL: https://hyros.com/ About the Job At HYROS , we help businesses understand exactly where their customers and revenue come from through advanced ad tracking and attribution. We're looking for an experienced Customer Success Manager with 5+ years of experience to own high-touch onboarding and customer success for key customers. This is not a purely relationship-focused CSM role. Onboarding at HYROS has a strong technical component. You'll need to understand how a customer's marketing and sales ecosystem works, help them connect the right platforms, troubleshoot setup issues, and make sure their tracking is working correctly. Your goal is clear: help customers get set up correctly, reach value fast, trust their data, and use HYROS to make better business decisions. This is a high-ownership role. You'll lead customer relationships, identify risks early, solve problems proactively, and be accountable for successful onboarding, adoption, and retention. What You'll Own & What Success Looks Like As a Customer Success Manager at HYROS, you'll be responsible for guiding customers through onboarding, helping them get real value from their data, and building strong relationships that support long-term retention. Your performance will be measured across four key areas: Customer Retention: The percentage of customers you successfully retain within your assigned portfolio. Customer Portfolio: The number of customers you manage while maintaining a high standard of service and engagement. Onboarding & Activation: How effectively you guide customers through technical implementation, complete their setup, and help them start using HYROS. Customer Satisfaction: The quality of your customer relationships, feedback, and ability to resolve issues proactively. What Success in This Role Looks Like First 30 Days — Learning & First Customers Understand HYROS, our onboarding playbooks, internal processes, and customer journey. Become familiar with our tracking technology, integrations, and common implementation challenges. Understand how platforms like Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, CRMs, and payment processors connect with HYROS. Start hosting onboarding calls and guiding your first customers through their setup. Learn how to troubleshoot common tracking, integration, and data validation issues. First 60 Days — Building Independence Confidently lead onboarding calls and guide customers through technical implementations. Become comfortable helping customers install tracking scripts, configure integrations, validate events, and troubleshoot setup issues. Independently manage your first customer portfolio and keep onboarding progress on track. Identify potential setup or engagement risks early and take action before they become bigger problems. Develop a strong understanding of how customers use HYROS data to improve their advertising decisions. First 90 Days — Full Ownership Take full ownership of your assigned customers, from onboarding through activation and ongoing adoption. Independently handle most common technical onboarding challenges, knowing when deeper technical support is needed. Run effective customer training sessions and explain complex tracking concepts in a simple, practical way. Help customers understand their attribution data and turn it into actionable business decisions. Proactively manage customer engagement, satisfaction, and retention risks. Maintain strong relationships and consistently positive customer feedback. First 180 Days — Consistent Performance Independently manage a growing customer portfolio while maintaining a high standard of customer service. Consistently deliver successful onboarding, strong adoption, and positive customer retention. Become a trusted advisor who helps customers make better marketing and business decisions using HYROS. Demonstrate strong technical confidence across common integrations, tracking setups, and troubleshooting scenarios. Identify opportunities to improve onboarding efficiency, customer experience, and retention. Contribute to improving internal playbooks, processes, and best practices. What We're Looking For 5+ years of Customer Success experience , ideally in SaaS. Experience managing high-touch or strategic customers. Strong understanding of customer onboarding, adoption, and retention. Comfort working in technical customer environments. You don't need to be a developer, but technical implementations shouldn't intimidate you. Hands-on familiarity with platforms such as Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify , or similar marketing and e-commerce platforms. Comfortable understanding how websites, funnels, tracking scripts, integrations, pixels/events, and customer data connect at a practical level. Able to troubleshoot logically, identify where a setup may be breaking, and clearly explain the solution to a customer. Excellent communication skills and the ability to make complex or technical topics simple. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently. Comfortable using data and customer signals to prioritize and take action. A proactive, ownership-driven mindset. You don't wait for problems to become escalations. Big Plus Experience with marketing analytics, paid advertising, ad tracking, attribution, conversion tracking, e-commerce, or technical SaaS products . Experience with platforms and tools such as Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, HubSpot, Intercom, or ChurnZero . Basic familiarity with concepts such as tracking scripts, pixels, events, domains, redirects, webhooks, APIs, UTMs, and CRM integrations . Previous experience managing customer portfolios with a strong focus on retention, customer satisfaction, and long-term adoption. Why HYROS? You'll have real ownership over a critical part of the customer journey and a direct impact on onboarding, adoption, retention, and customer success. You'll work at the intersection of Customer Success, marketing, data, and technology , helping businesses not only implement HYROS correctly but actually use it to make better decisions. This is an opportunity to work directly with customers, solve meaningful technical challenges, and see the impact of your work on their businesses. If you're an experienced CSM who enjoys building customer relationships but is also comfortable getting hands-on with technical setups, troubleshooting problems, and understanding how marketing technology works , we'd like to hear from you. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hyros-customer-success-manager-high-touch-onboarding

discovered_jobs.description_text: Headquarters: Remote - USA About the Role Abnormal AI is looking for a Director of Renewals to own the strategy, performance, and operating model for our global renewals function. Reporting to the VP of Customer Success, you will lead the renewals organization and own revenue retention across Abnormal's multi-product behavioral security platform. You will build the renewals engine that makes retention and cross-product expansion predictable at scale, set the standard for how Abnormal renews and expands its customers, and turn customer obsession into measurable retention outcomes. What you will do Own Abnormal's renewals strategy and operating model end to end: define the renewal motion, the segmentation approach, the playbooks, and the systems that enable the function to scale ahead with company growth. Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Renewal Managers/Specialists, setting clear goals and KPIs for renewal bookings, gross renewal retention, Upsell, and forecast accuracy. Manage and improve the full renewal lifecycle: engage early, negotiate terms, secure commitments, and collaborate with cross-functional teams (Customer Success, Sales, Ops, Finance) to ensure contract execution. Drive a data-driven renewal process: monitor pipeline health, identify at-risk accounts, implement preservation strategies, and report on renewal metrics (retention rates, forecast variance, etc.). Partner with Customer Success and Sales to identify expansion opportunities during renewal engagements and align on a joint renewal-and-expand motion. Develop and mature forecasting models for renewal bookings, churn, and NARR, presenting updates to senior leadership and driving improvements in predictability. Manage escalations and high-visibility renewal situations; support Renewal Managers/Specialists in complex negotiations or large-scale renewals. Stay current with SaaS licensing, pricing models, contract terms, and market trends in the email security / cybersecurity industry to ensure competitiveness and contract health. Must Haves 10+ years of experience in renewals, post-sales, or account management within a B2B SaaS environment; preferably with 4+ years managing direct reports. Proven track of owning gross retention as a top-line commitment at scale, with demonstrable improvement in retention and forecast accuracy across a full function Experience building or substantially maturing a renewals function: motion design, segmentation, playbooks, tooling, and the operating cadence behind them. Executive presence and influence: able to shape strategy with C-level internal peers and lead the highest-stakes customer negotiations. Strong quantitative and operational judgment: fluent in the forecasting models, retention economics, and systems (Salesforce, Gainsight) that run a modern renewals org. Strong communication and leadership skills with the ability to develop, motivate and retain a team. Strategic thinker who can improve and scale processes in a dynamic, high-growth environment. Experience building and operationalizing AI tools to improve renewals and post sales processes. Nice to Have Experience in email security, cybersecurity, or other highly regulated SaaS industries. Experience working in a high-volume renewal environment or managing large renewal books. Exposure to international renewal / multi-regional contract management. #LI-LM3 Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. Base salary range: $210,800 — $248,000 USD A note on AI in our process: Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards. Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. For our EEO policy statement please click here . If you would like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/abnormal-director-renewals

Wenn Sie eine Leidenschaft für Marketing und Landwirtschaft haben und in einem engagierten Umfeld arbeiten möchten, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen. Aufgaben Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Marketingstrategien zur Förderung der Dienstleistungen der Claudius Wurth Agrarberatung. Analyse von Markttrends und Wettbewerbern im Bereich der Agrarunternehmensberatung, um Wachstumschancen zu identifizieren. Koordination und Durchführung von Werbe- und PR-Kampagnen, einschließlich der Erstellung von Inhalten für verschiedene Medienkanäle. discovered_jobs.title: Director of Security Engineering
discovered_jobs.description_text: Headquarters: Remote - USA About the Role Abnormal AI protects organizations from the most sophisticated email and collaboration attacks using behavioral AI. Security is not a bolt-on at Abnormal; it is core to the product we sell and the trust our customers place in us. Our security organization operates a commercial cloud environment and a separate FedRAMP-authorized environment, and we are pursuing increasingly rigorous federal authorizations as we grow. We are hiring a Director of Security reporting to the CISO and leading the Security Engineering organization. You will build and scale high-performing security teams, own major security programs end to end, and operate autonomously in the CISO's absence, including representing security to executive leadership, customers, and auditors. This is a role for a deeply technical leader with a software engineering background who has grown into people leadership. You have built security teams from the ground up, you write and review code and architecture when it matters, and you believe the best security organizations earn their influence through partnership rather than policy enforcement. Our Security Philosophy We run security the way the best engineering-led companies do: Security reduces toil. Our job is to make the rest of the company faster and safer at the same time. If a control adds friction without reducing risk, it is a defect. Paved paths, safe by default. We invest in guardrails, golden paths, and secure-by-default infrastructure so the easy choice is the secure choice. We prefer preventing classes of problems over chasing individual findings. Partnership over gatekeeping. Security succeeds only through deep collaboration with engineering, IT, and business teams. We embed with builders, we ship alongside them, and we take on their constraints as our own. Engineering-grade rigor. We treat security problems as engineering problems: automated, measurable, code-reviewed, and continuously improved. If the security cultures that value freedom and responsibility, context over control, and guardrails over gates resonate with you, you will feel at home here. What You Will Do Serve as deputy to the CISO: act with full authority in the CISO's absence and represent the security organization to executives, customers, and regulators. Lead, coach, and grow managers and senior engineers across Security Engineering and Security Operations. Own the security engineering roadmap: cloud security architecture (AWS-first), detection and response, identity, vulnerability management, and secure-by-default platform investments. Drive cross-functional programs with Engineering, IT, and Product, from AI security governance to data perimeter controls to federal compliance initiatives. Set and defend engineering standards for the security organization: everything as code, automated where possible, measured against outcomes rather than activity. Build hiring pipelines and raise the bar on every hire; own performance management, promotion cases, and succession planning within your teams. Translate technical risk into business terms for the executive team and board, and translate business priorities into a coherent security strategy. Must Haves 10+ years in security or software engineering, including 4+ years managing security teams, ideally including managers of managers or equivalent scope. A genuine software engineering background: you have shipped production software, and you evaluate security solutions the way an engineer would. A proven record of building and scaling high-performing security teams, with alumni who would work for you again. Deep technical fluency in cloud-native environments: AWS organizations and multi-account governance, Kubernetes, identity and access, detection engineering, and modern SDLC security. Demonstrated cross-functional leadership: you have earned the trust of engineering leaders and shipped security outcomes through their teams, not around them. Strong written communication: you produce decision-ready documents and can drive alignment asynchronously. Executive presence: comfortable presenting to C-level leadership, customers, and auditors without preparation from the CISO. Strong Signals You are currently a security engineering manager or senior manager at a fintech, high-growth startup, or forward-leaning enterprise, and you are ready for broader scope. You have built paved-path or secure-by-default platforms that measurably reduced both risk and developer friction. Experience with compliance-driven environments (FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001) without letting compliance define the security program. Experience securing AI/ML systems or governing AI adoption at scale. You have operated in environments where security headcount was scarce and automation was the only way to scale. Why This Role You will inherit strong teams, an executive staff that treats security as a first-class function, and a CISO who wants a true partner rather than a lieutenant. The scope is broad, the autonomy is real, and the ceiling on this role is defined by what you take on. #LI-ML1 Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. Base salary range: $214,200 — $308,000 USD A note on AI in our process: Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards. Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. For our EEO policy statement please click here . If you would like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/abnormal-director-of-security-engineering

If a control adds friction without reducing risk, it is a defect. Paved paths, safe by default. We invest in guardrails, golden paths, and secure-by-default infrastructure so the easy choice is the secure choice. We prefer preventing classes of problems over chasing individual findings. Partnership over gatekeeping. Security succeeds only through deep collaboration with engineering, IT, and business teams. We embed with builders, we ship alongside them, and we take on their constraints as our own. Engineering-grade rigor. We treat security problems as engineering problems: automated, measurable, code-reviewed, and continuously improved. If the security cultures that value freedom and responsibility, context over control, and guardrails over gates resonate with you, you will feel at home here. What You Will Do Serve as deputy to the CISO: act with full authority in the CISO's absence and represent the security organization to executives, customers, and regulators. Lead, coach, and grow managers and senior engineers across Security Engineering and Security Operations. Own the security engineering roadmap: cloud security architecture (AWS-first), detection and response, identity, vulnerability management, and secure-by-default platform investments. Drive cross-functional programs with Engineering, IT, and Product, from AI security governance to data perimeter controls to federal compliance initiatives. Set and defend engineering standards for the security organization: everything as code, automated where possible, measured against outcomes rather than activity. Build hiring pipelines and raise the bar on every hire; own performance management, promotion cases, and succession planning within your teams. Translate technical risk into business terms for the executive team and board, and translate business priorities into a coherent security strategy. Must Haves 10+ years in security or software engineering, including 4+ years managing security teams, ideally including managers of managers or equivalent scope. A genuine software engineering background: you have shipped production software, and you evaluate security solutions the way an engineer would. A proven record of building and scaling high-performing security teams, with alumni who would work for you again. Deep technical fluency in cloud-native environments: AWS organizations and multi-account governance, Kubernetes, identity and access, detection engineering, and modern SDLC security. discovered_jobs.title: Director of Engineering - Content Platform (Catalog)
discovered_jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. This position sits at the heart of Spotify’s Content Platform, responsible for the systems that define, structure, and govern content across the platform. Our mission is to provide a trusted, consistent source of truth so content can be reliably managed and reused across every Spotify experience. We build and operate the core systems and workflows that ensure content is accurate, complete, and available, from APIs and lifecycle orchestration through to content quality and integrity. As Spotify’s content ecosystem continues to grow in scale and complexity across new formats, use cases, and regulatory environments, this domain plays a critical role in helping us scale intentionally while maintaining the trust and quality our users and creators expect. We’re seeking a Director of Engineering to lead this domain, shaping its technical direction, developing teams, and evolving the systems that underpin Spotify’s global content platform.

discovered_jobs.title: Chief Restructuring Officer
discovered_jobs.description_text: Chief Restructuring Officer (CRO) Position Overview We are seeking an experienced Chief Restructuring Officer (CRO) to lead a complex financial and operational restructuring. The CRO will work closely with the Board, management team, lenders, investors, legal counsel, and other key stakeholders to stabilize the business, improve liquidity and operating performance, and develop and execute a comprehensive restructuring plan. This individual must be a highly experienced, hands-on restructuring executive who can quickly assess the situation, establish credibility with stakeholders, and drive decisive action in a challenging and fast-moving environment. Key Responsibilities Lead the development and execution of the company’s financial and operational restructuring strategy. Immediately assess liquidity, cash requirements, operating performance, capital structure, and near-term business risks. Develop, implement, and actively manage a 13-week cash flow forecast and short-term liquidity plan. Identify opportunities to preserve cash, reduce costs, improve working capital, and stabilize operating performance. Partner with the CEO, CFO, Board, sponsors, and management team to establish restructuring priorities and execute against them. Serve as a primary point of contact with lenders, private credit investors, private equity sponsors, bondholders, and other financial stakeholders . Lead or support negotiations involving amendments, waivers, forbearance agreements, recapitalizations, refinancing, or other restructuring alternatives. Evaluate strategic alternatives including asset sales, business-unit divestitures, refinancing, recapitalization, distressed M&A, and potential Chapter 11 proceedings. Work closely with restructuring advisors, investment bankers, attorneys, and other outside professionals. Develop detailed business plans, financial forecasts, restructuring models, and scenario analyses. Identify underperforming business units, customers, products, or operations and implement corrective actions. Establish appropriate restructuring KPIs and provide frequent reporting to the Board and key stakeholders. Drive accountability throughout the organization and ensure restructuring initiatives are executed according to established timelines. Provide leadership to employees and management during periods of significant change and uncertainty. If necessary, lead the company through an in-court restructuring process, including DIP financing, first-day planning, creditor negotiations, asset sales, and emergence planning. Qualifications 15+ years of senior financial, operational, restructuring, or turnaround experience , with significant experience in distressed situations. Prior experience serving as a Chief Restructuring Officer, Chief Financial Officer, turnaround executive, restructuring advisor, or similar senior leadership role . Demonstrated experience managing companies facing liquidity constraints, covenant issues, operational deterioration, or other financial distress. Deep expertise in 13-week cash flow forecasting, liquidity management, working capital, financial modeling, and restructuring analysis . Strong understanding of leveraged capital structures, private credit, secured lending, and restructuring alternatives. Experience negotiating with lenders, sponsors, creditors, boards, and other sophisticated stakeholders. Experience with both out-of-court and Chapter 11 restructuring situations strongly preferred. Experience working with private equity-backed and/or highly leveraged businesses preferred. Strong operational orientation with the ability to move beyond analysis and personally drive implementation. Exceptional executive presence, communication skills, judgment, and ability to operate effectively in high-pressure situations. Bachelor’s degree required; MBA, CPA, CFA, CTP, or other relevant professional credentials preferred. Ideal Candidate Profile The successful candidate will combine financial restructuring expertise with strong operational instincts . This is not an advisory-only position. The CRO must be comfortable working inside the business, making difficult decisions, challenging assumptions, and driving execution. The ideal candidate will have successfully navigated multiple distressed situations and will be equally comfortable working with the management team on day-to-day liquidity issues and presenting a restructuring strategy to lenders, sponsors, and the Board. The CRO should bring a calm, credible presence to a difficult situation while maintaining a strong sense of urgency and accountability. Engagement Structure The position may be structured as an interim, consulting, or full-time executive engagement , depending on the circumstances and needs of the company. Significant interaction with the Board, lenders, investors, and outside restructuring professionals should be expected. Originally posted on Himalayas

discovered_jobs.title: Managing Director, TULIP GmbH & Commercial Leader, DACH  / Geschäftsführer (m/w/d), TULIP GmbH & Vertriebsleiter, DACH
discovered_jobs.description_text: DEUTSCH: Diese Position ist in München, Deutschland angesiedelt. Die TULIP GmbH und München ist der europäische Hauptsitz von TULIP. Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld und sind an 3+ Tagen pro Woche im Büro. Über TULIP TULIP ist die Frontline-Operations-Plattform, die Herstellern hilft, ihre Produktion zu digitalisieren, zu vernetzen und kontinuierlich zu verbessern – mit KI im Kern des Produkts. TULIP wurde am MIT (Massachusetts Institute of Technology) gegründet. Das Unternehmen hat seinen Hauptsitz in Boston, mit Büros in München, Tokio, Tel Aviv, Budapest und Singapur sowie Kundenstandorte in mehr als 45 Ländern. Im Januar 2026 schloss TULIP seine $120M Series-D-Finanzierungsrunde mit einer Unternehmensbewertung von 1,3 Mrd. USD ab. Führende globale Hersteller setzen auf TULIP, darunter VEKA, DMG MORI, Roche, AstraZeneca, Richemont, Saint-Gobain Aerospace und Mitsubishi Electric. Wir arbeiten mit NVIDIA, PwC, McKinsey, BCG und mehr als 160 Technologiepartnern weltweit zusammen. TULIP ist Teil der Global-Innovator-Community des Weltwirtschaftsforums, und unser CEO, Dr. Natan Linder, ist Co-Vorsitzender der Advanced Manufacturing Industry Governors Community des Forums. Die Chance für TULIP in der DACH-Region DACH ist das Herz der globalen Fertigungsindustrie. Deutschland ist die größte Industrienation Europas und die Geburtsstätte von Industrie 4.0. Die Schweiz ist ein globales Zentrum für Pharma-, Life-Science- und Präzisionsfertigung. Österreich ist ein starker Standort für Automobilbau, Maschinenbau, Metallverarbeitung und Halbleiter. Die Region beheimatet zudem zahlreiche „Hidden Champions" – mittelständische Unternehmen, die in globalen Nischenmärkten führend sind. Diese Unternehmen stehen heute vor ähnlichen Herausforderungen: Fachkräftemangel, steigende Qualitäts- und Compliance-Anforderungen sowie die Notwendigkeit, bestehende Werke zu modernisieren, ohne die Produktion zu unterbrechen. TULIP gibt den Frontline-Teams dieser Unternehmen ein KI-natives Produktionssystem an die Hand, um diesen Anforderungen zu begegnen und die Time-to-Value zu beschleunigen. Lokale Kunden vertrauen unserem Produkt in regulierten und hochpräzisen Produktionsumgebungen. Wir suchen nun einen Geschäftsführer (m/w/d) der TULIP GmbH & Vertriebsleiter für DACH . Sie verantworten das Wachstum der DACH-Region, führen das lokale Team und repräsentieren TULIP gegenüber Kunden, Partnern und Mitarbeitenden. Dabei haben Sie die Unterstützung eines globalen Unternehmens und echten Gestaltungsspielraum, wie wir in der DACH-Region gewinnen. Wichtigste Erfahrungen & Fähigkeiten: 10+ Jahre Erfahrung im Aufbau und Skalieren von B2B-SaaS-Geschäften im DACH-Markt Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Teamführung in Scale-up- und/oder Wachstumsphasen-Umgebungen mit globalem Bezug Starkes Netzwerk und hohe Glaubwürdigkeit bei Einkäufern aus Fertigung und Industrie in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz Nachweisliche Erfolgsbilanz beim Erreichen und Übertreffen von Umsatzzielen bei großen, komplexen Enterprise-Deals Erfahrung mit erstklassigen GTM-Tools wie Salesforce, Outreach, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator oder vergleichbaren Tools zur disziplinierten Umsetzung von Forecasting, Reporting und Pipeline-Management Herausragende Fähigkeiten im Vertrieb komplexer, hochwertiger B2B-SaaS-Lösungen in Fertigungsumgebungen sowie im Aufbau eines erfolgreichen Teams hierfür Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Wesentliche Verantwortlichkeiten: Leitung der TULIP GmbH als Geschäftsführer/in – Prägung von Unternehmenskultur, Betriebsabläufen und der Zusammenarbeit des lokalen Teams mit globalen Teams Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Go-to-Market-Wachstumsstrategie für DACH, in Zusammenarbeit mit der Commercial Leadership Erreichen der ARR-Wachstumsziele für das DACH-Geschäft über alle Branchenvertikalen hinweg Identifikation, Qualifizierung und Entwicklung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten mit Kunden; Aufbau starker Beziehungen zu regionalen Partnern, Vertriebskanälen und Ökosystem-Akteuren Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering, Legal, Customer Success und weiteren Teams zur Steuerung der Deal-Abwicklung Einstellung, Einarbeitung, Schulung und Mentoring neuer Vertriebsmitarbeitender für die Region im Zuge ihres Wachstums Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Vertriebsprozesse zur Unterstützung der regionalen Skalierung Wichtigste Ansprechpartner/Kollaborateure: Globale Commercial-Teams (z. B. Account Executives, Customer Success, Professional Services) Globale Marketing-Teams Geschäftsleitung Arbeiten bei TULIP Wir wissen, dass selbst großartige Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten manchmal am Hochstapler-Syndrom zweifeln. Auch wenn Sie nicht jede Anforderung erfüllen, lohnt sich eine Bewerbung – Sie geben uns damit die Möglichkeit, Sie in Betracht zu ziehen. Wir bauen ein starkes, vielfältiges Team auf, das harte Arbeit, Familien und persönliches Wohlbefinden wertschätzt. Zu unseren Benefits gehören: Direkter Einfluss auf Produkt und Unternehmenskultur Unternehmensanteile (Equity) Attraktives Benefits-Paket, inklusive Zuschüsse für den Arbeitsweg, Weiterbildungsbudget, Team-Events und drei Tage pro Woche Mittagessen Flexible Arbeitszeiten und unbegrenzter Urlaubsanspruch Ein inklusives, hundefreundliches Büro mit vielfältigen und inspirierenden Kolleginnen und Kollegen Virtuelle und Vor-Ort-Veranstaltungen sowie Happy Hours auf globaler Unternehmensebene Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit bietet. Bei TULIP feiern wir Vielfalt. Qualifizierte Bewerberinnen und Bewerber werden unabhängig von Herkunft, Religion, Hautfarbe, Nationalität, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Familienstand, Veteranenstatus oder Behinderung berücksichtigt. Helfen Sie uns, eine inklusive Gemeinschaft aufzubauen, die die Frontline-Operationen transformiert ENGLISH: This role is located in Munich, Germany. TULIP GmbH is a full operating entity and Munich is TULIP’s headquarters in Europe. We are a hybrid work environment and we are in the office 3+ days/per week. About TULIP TULIP is the frontline operations platform that helps manufacturers digitize, connect and continuously improve how they run production, with AI at the core of the product. TULIP was founded out of MIT. It is headquartered in Boston, has offices in Munich, Tokyo, Tel Aviv, Budapest and Singapore, and has customer sites in more than 45 countries. In January 2026, TULIP closed its $120M Series D at a company valuation of $1.3B. Leading global manufacturers run on TULIP, including VEKA, DMG Mori, Roche, AstraZeneca, Richemont, Saint-Gobain Aerospace and Mitsubishi Electric. We partner with NVIDIA, PwC, McKinsey, BCG and more than 160 technology partners worldwide. TULIP is part of the World Economic Forum's Global Innovator community, and our CEO, Dr. Natan Linder, co-chairs the Forum's Advanced Manufacturing Industry Governors Community.  The opportunity in DACH for TULIP DACH is the heart of global manufacturing. Germany is Europe's largest industrial economy and the birthplace of Industrie 4.0. Switzerland is a global centre for pharma, life sciences and precision manufacturing. Austria is a strong base in automotive, machinery, metals and semiconductors. The region is also home to many of the world's "Hidden Champions", mid-sized companies that lead global niche markets. Today, these companies face similar pressures: fewer skilled workers, rising quality and compliance demands, and the need to modernize existing plants without stopping production. TULIP gives their frontline teams an AI-native production system to meet those pressures and accelerate time-to-value. Local customers trust our product in regulated and high-precision environments. We are now hiring a Managing Director (Geschäftsführer, m/w/d) of TULIP GmbH & Commercial Leader for DACH. You will own the DACH region's growth, lead the local team, and represent TULIP to customers, partners and employees. You will have the backing of a global company and real room to shape how we win in DACH.  Key Experience & Skills:  10+ years of experience leading and scaling B2B SaaS businesses in the DACH market Significant experience leading teams in scale-up and/or growth-stage, global environments Strong network and credibility with manufacturing and industrial buyers in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland Track record of meeting and exceeding quota targets of large, complex enterprise deals Experience using first-class GTM tools such as Salesforce, Outreach, ZoomInfo, Linkedin Sales Navigator or similar tools to execute disciplined forecasting, reporting, and pipeline management Exceptional skills in selling complex, high-value B2B SaaS solutions into manufacturing environments and building a successful team to do the same Native or Fluent in German and Fluent in English to full business proficiency Key Responsibilities: Lead the TULIP Gmbh as its Managing Director, setting the tone for culture, operations, and how the local team works with global teams Own and execute the DACH go-to-market growth strategy, in partnership with Commercial Leadership Achieve ARR growth objectives for the DACH business across verticals Identify, qualify, and develop new opportunities with customers; build strong relationships with regional partners, channels, and ecosystem players Partner closely with Engineering, Legal, Customer Success and other groups to drive deal execution Hire, onboard, train, and mentor new DACH sales team members as the region grows Continuously improve sales processes to support regional scale Key Collaborators: Global Commercial Teams (e.g., AEs, Customer Success, Professional Services) Global Marketing Teams Executive Leadership Working At Tulip We know even great candidates experience imposter syndrome. Even if you don’t match every requirement, applying gives you the opportunity to be considered.  We’re building a strong, diverse team that values hard work, families, and personal well-being. Benefits of working with us include: Direct impact on product and culture Company equity Competitive benefits package including commuter benefits, learning and development stipend, team events, catered lunches 3 days a week Flexible work schedule and unlimited vacation policy An inclusive, dog-friendly office with diverse and inspiring colleagues Virtual and in-office global company events and happy hours We are an equal opportunity employer. At Tulip, we celebrate all. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Help us build an inclusive community that will transform frontline operations.  It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. Please note that we may use AI-based tools to support parts of our hiring process. All data processing is carried out in compliance with local data protection laws, ensuring all personal candidate information is handled securely and ethically. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

discovered_jobs.description_text: Leverage Live Local prepares and manages Florida Live Local Act property tax exemptions for multifamily owners. We represent more than 90 properties and about 30,000 units. Demand is not our constraint. Operations is. This seat owns the operating system that lets us grow without breaking. What's in it for you. A base of 180,000 dollars with upside tied to the numbers you own, full compensation likely 250,000 to 350,000 dollars when the role is performing. Direct weekly access to the founder. Twenty days of paid time off plus federal holidays. Fully remote. What you own Every exemption application submitted correctly and on time, every cycle Decision tracking by the statutory deadline, logged in the system of record Denials and appeals, every one, with deadlines met The annual recertification and compliance cadence The operations team: SLAs, data hygiene, accountability One shared source of truth for the team, the software, and our clients Your scorecard at 90 days and 6 months. On time filing, denial rate, contract to filing ready, recurring compliance completion, and founder escalations. Legal deadlines are 100 percent from day one. Full targets are on our careers page. This is for you if you have walked into a messy, growing services business and made it run tight, you like being measured on real numbers, and you have managed a team of three or more. You must be able to work core hours overlapping 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern US time. This is not for you if you have never owned operations for a multi million dollar service business, you would rather build strategy decks than run a daily operating rhythm, or you want a strict nine to five. Compensation and benefits Performance upside tied to the five scorecard numbers Direct weekly founder access 20 days PTO plus US federal holidays 500 dollars per month health stipend 1,000 dollar home office stipend 1,200 dollars per year professional development How to apply. Answer these screening questions in your application note: what metrics did you track in your last role and what were they when you started versus when you left; how many people have you directly managed (minimum 3); have you owned a process with hard regulatory or external deadlines; can you work core hours that overlap 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern; does a base salary of 180,000 dollars work for you. Shortlisted candidates get a short video about the role and a written and Loom exercise with a deadline. Please mention the word **HOMAGE** and tag RMTg1LjEyOC45LjEyNQ== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMTg1LjEyOC45LjEyNQ==). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Working knowledge of CPQ (Salesforce CPQ, Apttus); pricing through M&A integration or a major commercial model transition. MBA a plus. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential. management Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes Continuously monitor and improve grievances and appeals processes to ensure ongoing compliance with CMS and state regulatory requirements Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff Stay current on emerging fraud, waste, and abuse trends and lead efforts to proactively identify and investigate potential FWA Review results across all three departments and identify process improvement initiatives and cost savings opportunities Analyze department and operational data in Excel to identify trends and draw actionable insights Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise Interact directly with customers as needed Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others Develop, maintain, and report statistical measurements assessing the effectiveness of the QA, FWA, and G&A programs Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C discovered_jobs.title: Director, Portfolio & Monetization Architecture
discovered_jobs.description_text: Spotify's growth depends on offering the right thing to the right listener at the right price, moving beyond one-size-fits-all packaging toward a portfolio where listeners can mix and match what they value most. The evolution of our subscription portfolio, and how we monetize it, is one of Spotify’s most important strategic opportunities in the years ahead. We’re looking for a Director to lead the strategic design of that portfolio end to end, shaping the architecture of tiers, add-ons, bundles, and the broader pricing ecosystem. This role will help define how the portfolio works today and how it evolves over the coming years to better serve listeners while driving sustainable growth. As the strategic engine behind our portfolio architecture, you’ll combine commercial intuition, consumer understanding, behavioral data, and real-world market signals to build conviction behind critical decisions. Working closely with cross-functional partners and senior leaders, you’ll help determine what belongs in Premium, what moves into new monetization layers, and how Spotify’s subscription offering continues to evolve for millions of listeners around the world.
